replace: 100% { border-width: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px currentColor; transform: scale(1); }
why: The emptied pip's cue ends on the held pip's fill (issue #1022's review). Fill mode `both` holds the last frame until the strip next rebuilds, so the pip the player just lost stays a 3px ring rather than the lost pip's 2px one. This is the negative control of the test that pins every frame before the last to the held pip: the same assertion requires the last frame to be the bare 2px ring.
